proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8201.5 *pippīḍa explicitly gives Bengali pipiṛā/pĩp(i)ṛā ant. Survey pipɽa selects this retroflex branch, retaining the unnasalized spelling documented in the article. Exact survey form pipɽa is preserved.
